author: Erah
text:
Your sentences are closer to paint on a canvas.
This page, empty otherwise, grows from the accumulated
offerings and edits of those before you - after you
things will change, as they always do.

But, this time,
instead of your name fading amongst the howling of hourglass sand - silencing.
The tethered echo of you and your work remains.
Each grain now is signed. The hourglass shows the passage of time
through the hands that shape it.

Feel free to change this text. Each word is a grain of sand. Sentences are strokes of paint. 
Break out the duct tape, replace with magazine cutouts - each edit shows your hand. My voice here
existing as the initial offerings: I want you to change it. My voice here
will not be truly erased though some words are gone by the time you see this. Our voices here
accumulate in the choices. 

Now:

What will you choose?
